title: Why SoftBank weighed a US$1 trillion SK Hynix buyout before backing off
html:
SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son recently approached Wall Street banks about financing a potential US$1 trillion buyout of South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix, The Information reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
